topic: A teacher receives an unexpected gift from a former student
text: Oh my gosh, can you believe it? This former student, who I taught like, ages ago, showed up at my door! And get this, they brought me this absolutely gorgeous plant, in this rustic pot like you wouldn't believe. They said it was because they never forgot my encouragement and how much it meant to them. I mean, who does that? But it’s just the sweetest thing, and I’ve been showing it to everyone. The plant's got these little blooms too, so delicate and strong at the same time. It’s like a perfect little metaphor for what I’ve always tried to teach—growth, resilience, and all that jazz. I can’t stop thinking about it, and how amazing it feels to know I made a difference.
